known_text: You've done what you needed to do.

use.known: You did everything you needed to do yesterday.
use.target: 你昨天做了你需要做的一切。

use.known: If you practice more, you will speak better.
use.target: 如果你多练习，你会说得更好。

use.known: She asked if you finished the work on time.
use.target: 她问你是不是按时完成了工作。

use.known: They want to know what you did at the office.
use.target: 他们想知道你在办公室做了什么。

use.known: Nobody told me you already finished everything.
use.target: 没有人告诉我你已经完成了一切。

use.known: Did you have a chance to talk with her about this?
use.target: 你有机会和她说这个吗？

use.known: You finished doing what you needed to do today.
use.target: 你今天做完了你需要做的。

use.known: She said she will do it if you help her first.
use.target: 她说如果你先帮她，她会做。

use.known: If nobody can do it, we will have a problem.
use.target: 如果没有人能做，我们会有问题。

use.known: They asked what we need to do before tomorrow.
use.target: 他们问我们明天之前需要做什么。

use.known: Everyone wants to know how you did it so fast.
use.target: 大家都想知道你怎么这么快做完了。

use.known: Did you finish doing the things she asked you?
use.target: 你做完了她让你做的事吗？

use.known: You finished everything you needed to do today.
use.target: 你今天做完了你需要做的一切。

use.known: She already told us what happened at the office.
use.target: 她已经告诉了我们办公室发生了什么。

use.known: If you finished, please let me know right away.
use.target: 如果你做完了，请马上让我知道。

use.known: They said they already did what they needed to.
use.target: 他们说他们已经做了他们需要做的。

use.known: Everyone finished their work before the meeting.
use.target: 大家在开会之前完成了他们的工作。

use.known: Did you know she already finished everything?
use.target: 你知道她已经完成了一切吗？

use.known: You did what you needed to do this morning.
use.target: 你今天早上做了你需要做的。

use.known: She said she needs to finish before tomorrow.
use.target: 她说她需要在明天之前完成。

use.known: If you need help, please ask anyone at the office.
use.target: 如果你需要帮忙，请问办公室的任何人。

use.known: They told us what we need to do before leaving.
use.target: 他们告诉了我们走之前需要做什么。

use.known: Everyone needs to practice if they want to improve.
use.target: 大家都需要练习如果他们想变好。

use.known: Did you finish what you needed to do yesterday?
use.target: 你昨天做完了你需要做的吗？

use.known: You finished doing what you needed to do today.
use.target: 你今天做完了你需要做的。

use.known: The work she did yesterday was very important.
use.target: 她昨天做的工作很重要。

use.known: If you know the answer, please tell us about it.
use.target: 如果你知道回答，请告诉我们关于那个的事。

use.known: They asked about the things we talked about before.
use.target: 他们问了关于我们以前说的事。

use.known: Everyone likes the work you did at the office.
use.target: 大家都喜欢你在办公室做的工作。

use.known: Did you understand the things she told you?
use.target: 你了解她告诉你的事吗？
